headword: {面|つら}の{皮|かわ}が{厚|あつ}い

definitions.explanation: Describes a person who is impervious to embarrassment or criticism, acting without shame even when their behavior is clearly inappropriate. Literally means 'the skin of one's face is thick.'

examples.japanese: ⟦あの{人|ひと}→あの人：25922_anohito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{面|つら}の{皮|かわ}が{厚|あつ}い。
⟦{嘘|うそ}→嘘：01796_uso⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ばれて→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{平気|へいき}→平気：00095_heiki⟧で⟦いられる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦なんて→なんて：06918_nante⟧、{面|つら}の{皮|かわ}が{厚|あつ}い。
examples.english: Being able to stay calm even when caught in a lie — how shameless.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧せいにしておいて、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{面|つら}の{皮|かわ}が{厚|あつ}く⟦{居座|いすわ}っている→居座る：15930_isuwaru⟧。
examples.english: Even after blaming their own mistakes on others, they're brazenly staying put.

notes:
Literally "the skin of one's face is thick" — a vivid idiom meaning someone is so brazen that criticism bounces right off them. Always used negatively, to criticize someone who acts without shame. The word ⟦{面|つら}→面：02231_tsura⟧ is a rougher, more colloquial way to say ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (face).

USAGE:
Almost always used to criticize or express exasperation at someone's shamelessness. Can be used as a predicate ({面|つら}の{皮|かわ}が{厚|あつ}い) or as a modifier ({面|つら}の{皮|かわ}が{厚|あつ}く...).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{厚|あつ}かましい→厚かましい：09161_atsukamashii⟧: impudent, brazen — a direct adjective meaning shameless; less idiomatic
- ⟦{図々|ずうずう}しい→図々しい：06535_zuuzuushii⟧: brazen, nervy — similar meaning; slightly more colloquial
- ⟦{恥知|はじし}らず→恥知らず：21065_hajishirazu⟧: shameless person — a noun directly calling someone shameless
- ⟦{鉄面皮|てつめんぴ}→鉄面皮：15954_tetsumenpi⟧: brazen-faced — more literary; literally "iron face skin"
